recipe.visualDefinition: A four-panel grid featuring stylized character profiles in profile view, set against a stark white background within a thick dark frame. The characters exhibit distinct color palettes and accessories, rendered with bold black outlines and minimal cel-shaded depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Uniform profile orientation across all four quadrants
High contrast between white panel backgrounds and dark outer border
Consistent line weight connecting disparate character designs
Symmetrical grid division using thick perpendicular lines
coreInvariants: Right-facing profile perspective for all subjects
Solid white background within each individual cell

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects centered in individual quadrants, occupying approximately 70% of each cell's height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central cross-hair intersection of the grid lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from top-left, moving across and down through each character profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space surrounding each head to emphasize silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy or black for the outer frame and grid lines.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the internal panel backgrounds.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted, desaturated earth tones and jewel tones for character skin and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation for character skin tones contrasted against high-value white backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 'O' and sharp 'A' vertices.
Provides the wide, circular geometric aesthetic.
Modern clean sans-serif with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 2x2 grid of four distinct character profiles facing right. Use heavy black outlines and cel shading. Place each character on a white background. Enclose the entire grid in a thick dark navy border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white. Center one word at the top margin and two words at the bottom margin, using wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text white and centered in the dark border?
Are the outlines thick and consistent?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is inside the white panels
Check that all four profiles are strictly side-view
Verify the dark border is uniform on all sides
Confirm the font is a clean geometric sans-serif
recipe.reuseFormula: 2x2 Profile Grid + Heavy Outlines + Geometric Sans Border Text
